ResearchTabDef.label: All-Bamba Tech
ResearchTabDef.generalTitle: Researches for items in All-Bamba series
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Unlock weapons from all kinds of tech levels.

ResearchProjectDef.label: charge specialist weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Charged weapons are not limited to the usual general-purpose designs. These platforms use the same technology in weapons made for specific tactical uses.

ResearchProjectDef.label: charge heavy weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: The same charged-weapon systems can be built into larger and more demanding platforms. These weapons give up portability for greater firepower, longer range, or more sustained output.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced charge weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refinements to the charge system have made it possible to push more energy into a projectile with less waste. The result is a weapon that hits harder, penetrates better, and makes more efficient use of its ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced specialized weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Better control over the charge allows weapons to be built around specific roles rather than compromises. Precision, compactness, and sustained fire can each be pursued without giving up the advantages of charged ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced heavy weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: The improved charge system can be scaled up to weapons that demand considerably more power. Better heat management and energy transfer keep that power useful instead of simply making the weapons heavier and harder to handle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Ballistic Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Conventional firearms still have plenty of room for improvement. Better materials, improved ammunition, and updated firing mechanisms can push ballistic weapons far past their usual limits, all without changing the basic principle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Specialized Ballistic Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Modern ballistic weapons can be tailored more closely to their intended roles. By using specialized actions, ammunition, and handling systems, each design can focus on the qualities that matter most for its purpose.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Heavy Ballistic Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: There really is no substitute for putting more gun into a gun. Heavy ballistic weapons use larger cartridges, stronger actions, and better recoil systems to deliver a lot more firepower.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glitterworld ballistic weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: There is hardly anything left to change in the basic firearm. What remains is the careful elimination of every possible source of error, waste, vibration, and inconsistency that less advanced manufacturing still has to accept.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glitterworld specialized ballistic weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: With manufacturing tolerances measured in fractions too tiny to see, specialized firearms can be designed for extremely narrow requirements. Each part is made for a single purpose, and it does that job with impressive consistency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glitterworld heavy ballistic weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: The same level of precision can be used for weapons where recoil, heat, and mechanical stress become real engineering challenges. Advanced materials and manufacturing let these weapons handle huge amounts of regular ammunition without giving up control or reliability.

ResearchProjectDef.label: spacer launchers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock spacer-tier disposable launchers that build on basic launcher design with higher-grade components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ultra launchers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock ultra-tier disposable launchers requiring advanced fabrication equipment and deeper launcher expertise.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMP launchers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop electromagnetic pulse launchers specialized for disabling electronics and cybernetic systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: toxic launchers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research specialized toxic launchers that deliver chemical payloads with advanced containment and dispersal mechanisms.
